summary: The implementation covers all 10 requirements for the fixed 17-operation system. The backend establishes a stable Operations data structure with pre-populated 17 operations, a getAllOperations query function, validation in createDailyProductionReport and updateDailyProductionReport, and migration logic. The frontend updates ContainerDailyReportEntryPage, ContainerDailyReportPage (implied via ProductionDashboardTable), and all dashboard/history components to display operations in sequential order 1-17. The useGetAllOperations hook is implied to be implemented. Comprehensive validation is added in the save functionality. All acceptance criteria appear to be addressed based on the diff evidence.
